ruleset.name: loudsight
ruleset.description: Loudsight project-specific rules, layered on top of PMD's bundled categories.

rule.name: NoDefaultZoneNow
rule.message: Timestamps are UTC instants: use TimeProvider.DEFAULT.now(), or pass an explicit zone such as LocalDateTime.now(ZoneOffset.UTC). See TimeProvider.
rule.description: Bans the zero-argument java.time now() factories, which read the JVM default time zone.

property.name: xpath
property.value: //MethodCall[ pmd-java:matchesSig('java.time.LocalDateTime#now()') or pmd-java:matchesSig('java.time.LocalDate#now()') or pmd-java:matchesSig('java.time.LocalTime#now()') or pmd-java:matchesSig('java.time.ZonedDateTime#now()') or pmd-java:matchesSig('java.time.OffsetDateTime#now()')] | //MethodReference[@MethodName='now'] [TypeExpression/ClassType[ pmd-java:typeIsExactly('java.time.LocalDateTime') or pmd-java:typeIsExactly('java.time.LocalDate') or pmd-java:typeIsExactly('java.time.LocalTime') or pmd-java:typeIsExactly('java.time.ZonedDateTime') or pmd-java:typeIsExactly('java.time.OffsetDateTime')]]

rule.name: InterruptFlagOnlyForInterruptedException
rule.message: Restore the interrupt status only when catching InterruptedException. Split the multi-catch: setting the flag for an IOException permanently poisons a pooled thread. See HttpDispatcherClient.send.
rule.description: Flags Thread.currentThread().interrupt() inside a catch block whose caught type is anything other than exactly InterruptedException, including any multi-catch.
